summary: The ReportMenu interface facilitates the management and viewing of various reports related to student and staff assignments, HR information, placement schedules, and invoicing within the HSPnet system. It employs a tabbed interface to organize different report categories and user controls to handle specific report types.
purpose: The purpose of the ReportMenu is to provide users with a structured and accessible interface for generating and managing reports concerning student and staff activities, HR details, and placement scheduling. It aims to streamline report access and provide role-based visibility and control over different report sections.

workflows.name: Load Report Workflow
steps: Activate the corresponding view based on the selected tab and user role.
Load specific report content using user controls.

workflows.name: Tab Click Workflow
steps: Identify the command argument associated with the clicked tab.
Bind data controls if necessary and display report content.

business_rules: User roles determine the visibility and accessibility of report sections.
Configuration settings (like UseStudentHRInformation or UseInvoicingModule) influence tab activation and access permissions.
validations: Ensure included and visible lists do not exceed predefined item counts.
Ensure date ranges are valid (start date must be before or the same as end date).
conditions: TabPanelHRInformation is enabled if UseStudentHRInformation is enabled and appropriate user roles are present.
Tabs and reports are activated based on user session roles and configurations.
system_behavior: Auto-generate UI controls for report interaction.
Register client-side scripts for dynamic UI behavior and validations.
